definitions.explanation: To load data or a file into a computer or device for processing.

definitions.gloss: to read thoroughly; to study deeply
definitions.explanation: To read something carefully and repeatedly until one has absorbed its content completely.

examples.japanese: ファイルを{読|よ}み{込|こ}む。
アプリがデータを{読|よ}み{込|こ}んでいる。
{画像|がぞう}ファイルの{読|よ}み{込|こ}みに{時間|じかん}がかかっている。
examples.english: Loading the image file is taking time.

examples.japanese: {台本|だいほん}を{読|よ}み{込|こ}む。
{試験|しけん}{前|まえ}に{教科書|きょうかしょ}を{何度|なんど}も{読|よ}み{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I read the textbook over and over before the exam.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{契約書|けいやくしょ}を{隅|すみ}から{隅|すみ}まで{読|よ}み{込|こ}んでから{署名|しょめい}した。
examples.english: He read the contract thoroughly from corner to corner before signing.

notes:
{読|よ}み{込|こ}む is a transitive godan verb that combines {読|よ}む (to read) and {込|こ}む (into, deeply). The {込|こ}む element adds the nuance of thoroughness or inward movement.

ASPECT (ている):
{読|よ}み{込|こ}んでいる can mean either "is currently loading" (ongoing action for sense 1) or "has studied thoroughly" (resulting state for sense 2).

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- Xを{読|よ}み{込|こ}む (load X / read X thoroughly)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- データを{読|よ}み{込|こ}む (load data)
- ファイルを{読|よ}み{込|こ}む (load a file)
- {台本|だいほん}を{読|よ}み{込|こ}む (study a script)

The noun form {読|よ}み{込|こ}み is commonly used in computing to mean "loading" (e.g., {読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう} = now loading).
